id: title:Gilbert09:stop reporting a self recovering hot standby conflict as an exception

review.posthog_relevance: Adds PostgreSQL recovery conflict errors to retryable connection errors, potentially improving warehouse ingestion resilience against transient database recovery conflicts.
review.reason: Adds PostgreSQL recovery conflict errors to retryable connection errors, potentially improving warehouse ingestion resilience against transient database recovery conflicts.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on supplied hunks; broader context and complete implementation are unavailable. No evidence of actual recovery or incident avoidance.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are available; no other hunks, PR metadata, or broader context are provided, so this review is limited to these two hunks.

observations.behavior: Adds the PostgreSQL error substring 'conflict with recovery' to the set of retryable connection errors.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the Postgres warehouse ingestion connector to retry a connection failure caused by a database recovery conflict, rather than treating it as a permanent failure. This could help recover from transient recovery conflicts on read-only or pooled connections without requiring a full re-establishment or manual intervention.

observations.behavior: Adds a PostgreSQL error message containing 'canceling statement due to conflict with recovery' to the list of retryable errors in a test, alongside the substring added in P1.F1.H1.
observations.code_quote: "canceling statement due to conflict with recovery\nDETAIL:  User query might have needed to see row versions that must be removed.",
observations.posthog_connection: Updates tests to recognize the same recovery-conflict condition, ensuring that the retry behavior is verified and not accidentally classified as a non-retryable exhausted-retry abort.
